$comment: Hard lightweight constraint (brief §2). CI fails if actuals exceed these. Raising a budget is a deliberate, reviewed decision — justify it in the PR. distKb measures the CORE/default packages only; optInPackages are summoned (D-001), not on the default path, so they don't count toward the core budget (they may carry their own budget later). distKb is 201 because the user-agent-bridges CLI commands and the observer dispatch live in the counted CLI entry (D-046). The observer implementation is the opt-in brain package, loaded only for init/hook/serve.
